source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?genreLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item ?sitelinks (SAMPLE(?g) AS ?genre) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?nG) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q7889 ; wdt:P136 ?g ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . FILTER(?sitelinks >= 14) FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item wdt:P852 ?esrb . VALUES ?esrb { wd:Q14864331 wd:Q14864332 wd:Q110488287 wd:Q124356066 } } } GROUP BY ?item ?sitelinks ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 700 } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?nG = 1) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 394
